description: This PHP source file defines the WorkShiftAPI class which provides REST API endpoints for managing work shifts in the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting work shift records, along with validation rules and related data handling.

classes.name: WorkShiftAPI
classes.description: API class for managing work shift entities, providing endpoints for CRUD operations.
